description: List or fetch parsed `<emu-table>` content. Pass `id` to get one table with full columns + rows; omit `id` to list tables (lightweight summaries) optionally filtered by caption/id substring. Authoritative source for the well-known intrinsics table (id='table-well-known-intrinsic-objects'), well-known symbols, completion record fields, etc. `spec` selects '262' or '402'.

edition.description: Edition within the chosen spec. ECMA-262: es2016 … es2026, main. ECMA-402: es2016 … es2026, main. Aliases: latest, draft, next.

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on the caption or id (list mode only).

id.description: If set, return exactly this table (full columns + rows). If omitted, list tables (lightweight rows).

limit.description: Max table summaries returned in list mode (ignored when 'id' is set).

spec.description: Which TC39 spec to read: '262' (core language, default) or '402' (Internationalization API).

name: spec.tables
title: Spec tables
